items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I was with Red Norvo for a number of years.

ctx.x: How did this come about? A wooden flute?

Oh yeah, I wanted to tell you about that. I was with Red Norvo for a number of years. I went to Las Vegas, Tahoe. And so he used to go on the road with Frank Sinatra. In fact the record came out recently with Frank Sinatra with the Red Norvo group. So we were playing in Palm Springs and we went over to Frank’s house. I played piano for Frank. He sang “Lady is a Tramp.”

items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Like the last one I had, oh it was -- it was Sam Most, and Gene Cherico... who else did I have on drums? Oh, I had J. C. Heard.

ctx.x: Like the last one I had, oh it was -- it was Sam Most, and Gene Cherico, who works with Sinatra now and who else did I have on drums? Oh, I had J. C. Heard.
